task: Core 1186 U11B: bounded staging Office RLS migration dependency reconciliation and rollback rehearsal

assuranceCeiling.rationale: The actual waterk-staging Office tables are empty but retain three broad authenticated ALL RLS policies, no participant table/current-user reader, and no browser/service table grants. The old privacy migration references evaluate_store_capability_v1, which is absent; the newer Block 11 plan-grant model is present. This release creates only a machine-verifiable dry-run dependency/rollback execution plan and negative role matrix, never applies stale migrations or alters database state. A separate deployment phase must prove staging role behavior and rollback before any DDL.

acceptanceCriteria: Read-only staging and source-fact reconciliation blocks direct replay of any historical Office migration with missing SQL dependencies or an obsolete plan-sync body.
Release plan enumerates actor/nonparticipant/cross-tenant/Alap/Pro/downgrade/no-session/service-role cases and explicitly marks all unexecuted behavior NOT_VERIFIED.
Three legacy RLS ALL policies, missing participant table/current-user helper/role grants and missing evaluate_store_capability_v1 are surfaced separately as release prerequisites.
Output includes ordered prerequisite stages, rollback boundaries, backup checks, schema-migration ledger lineage, exact environment identity and follow-up test conditions.
Staging is not modified in U11B rehearsal; no false U11B 'RLS fixed' or #1186 DONE statement is emitted from metadata-only evidence.
All full CI, Development Guard, Truth and Lifecycle evidence passes on the exact implementation SHA before merging the rehearsal work.
invariants: Apply only to the explicitly selected waterk-staging project; never touch production, service role secrets, tenant data or live plan grants.
Do not overwrite private.sync_webshop_plan_entitlements; Block 11 plan_capability_grants is the authoritative tenant entitlement model.
Alap baseline support_tickets and transactional email paths are independent and must remain permitted.
No automatic RLS activation from static source checks; the actual DDL release requires rollback/role-behavior authority.
Public actor-parameter SECURITY DEFINER helpers must not be callable by ordinary authenticated or anon users.
Missing runtime functions, SQL grants or historical migration lineage causes BLOCK, never an implicit positive permission test.
forbiddenStates: Stale 20260909204825/20260910061815 fixed-array plan-sync migrations are applied directly to staging.
The historical privacy foundation is replayed even though public.evaluate_store_capability_v1 does not exist in staging.
RLS success is asserted based solely on empty Office tables or on a query executed as a privileged SQL owner.
Authenticated user able to call actor-parameterized or privileged mutation RPC after migration.
Office table RLS repair hides or breaks independent Alap support tickets.
A planned rollback is claimed performed, despite no transactional rehearsal of the actual DDL.

failureModes: RLS read helper references an absent capability RPC and fails at runtime despite syntactically valid DDL.
Tenant plan-sync is replaced by a legacy fixed capability array, causing upgrade/downgrade drift.
Permissive OR RLS permits Alap or nonparticipants even with a restrictive-looking secondary policy.
Authenticated actor can impersonate another user by invoking a public SECURITY DEFINER actor-parameterized RPC.
Data API table grants are absent; Pro tenant browser never receives rows even with valid RLS.
Service-role bypass and function default privileges produce unobserved direct access paths.
A failed transactional deployment applies partial migrations or cannot restore policies.
Empty staging Office tables mask missing role-based allow/deny coverage.
edgeCases: Staging has no Office rows but nonempty support_tickets; separate path must remain unaffected.
All three Office tables are RLS enabled, yet authenticated and service roles have no explicit table grants.
Cross-tenant attacker has valid platform or support role in an unrelated shop only.
Pro downgrades to Alap with cached feature_entitlements and active sessions.
Old migrations are absent from ledger despite future-dated applied migrations, so version order cannot establish provenance.
private.current_user_can_read_office_thread_v1 must call auth.uid, not accept arbitrary actor UUID.
Alap has teamChat and officeCommunication capability grants but not officeCommunicationAdvanced.
Support UI pages use separate ticket tables, while Pro Office threads and messages require stricter access.

alternatives.summary: Derive a deterministic dependency/rollback rehearsal from canonical Office-readiness and actual staging schema, with explicit denial cases before a later DDL rollout.
alternatives.reason: Blocks stale migration replay and provides an auditable exact-source map without risking tenant access.

alternatives.summary: Apply the archived 20260908 and 20260910 SQL files in lexical order.
alternatives.reason: The environment lacks capability RPC and old plan-sync is incompatible with canonical Block 11 grants.

alternatives.summary: Replace only three RLS policies without participant table, grants and helper dependencies.
alternatives.reason: Would either lock out Pro users or incorrectly permit Alap/cross-tenant traffic and overstate dependency closure.

specialistReviews.finding: Office schema and runtime were built across multiple interdependent historical migrations, while staging is not aligned by version.
specialistReviews.resolution: Use source-to-target dependency matching and stage each missing object before planning any privileged SQL.

specialistReviews.finding: A policy shape check cannot prove authenticated allow/deny and cannot validate bypass through public definer RPCs.
specialistReviews.resolution: List explicit role/tenant/plan/participant negative tests and prohibit readiness claims until executed in a disposable rehearsal and staging.

specialistReviews.finding: Staging Block 11 grants and sync function are live and must not be reverted by a historical migration.
specialistReviews.resolution: Exclude legacy plan-sync from permissible SQL actions and require rollback/ledger checkpoints.

challenge.scenario: SQL migration is run against waterk-staging without knowing which dependency functions exist.
challenge.finding: Legacy helper evaluate_store_capability_v1 missing, deployment may fail mid-transaction.
challenge.resolution: Require catalog dependency signature match and reject source scripts until prerequisite synthesis.

challenge.scenario: A legacy sync migrates Alap Team Chat and Office into fixed grants.
challenge.finding: Current Block 11 entitlements become stale or inconsistent.
challenge.resolution: Require normalized grant table and existing sync to remain untouched; compare hashes before/after.

challenge.scenario: Privileged SQL owner reads no rows after RLS update.
challenge.finding: An empty table is not evidence of correct tenant access.
challenge.resolution: Require disposable actor/tenant fixtures and role-specific allow and deny assertions.

challenge.scenario: Service role can execute an actor-parameter function that browsers also inherit from PUBLIC.
challenge.finding: RPC actor spoofing and cross-tenant leakage.
challenge.resolution: Inspect ACL/default grants and test no anon/authenticated EXECUTE on such RPC.

challenge.scenario: Staging table has no authenticated SELECT grant.
challenge.finding: Even correct Pro RLS yields permission-denied user requests.
challenge.resolution: Require both table grant and RLS tests in the same evidence chain.

challenge.scenario: Office reader remains allowed after downgrade because cache or stale entitlement row survives.
challenge.finding: Alap accesses Pro mailbox after cancellation.
challenge.resolution: Prove live subscription_plan against current normalized plan capability under expiry/revocation.

challenge.scenario: Migration is marked applied in history without source identity proof.
challenge.finding: Later deploy skips necessary security changes or replays them.
challenge.resolution: Require exact migration SHA/content identity, backup and ledger check.

challenge.scenario: Private participant drops membership yet retains browser reader.
challenge.resolution: Test joined/left and cross-tenant matrix after real policy deployment.

proofPlan: Verify main SHA and merge/post-merge success before plan; read staging schema ACL, RLS, migration ledger and sample-free table counts.
Run exact Development Guard and Plan Before Code PASS for U11B dry-run files prior to implementation.
Implement a deterministic read-only staged-rehearsal resolver layered on U11A readiness report, not a new entitlement controller.
Add negative fixtures for missing dependency, grants, tables, service-role RPC exposures, incomplete role proof and stale lineage.
Report migration stages/stop conditions/rollback prerequisites; do not create or apply SQL in this phase.
Complete quality tests, typecheck, build, incremental replay, Truth, Lifecycle; mark U11B rehearsal closed only within its bounded claim.
Before actual DDL, generate a canonical migration via Supabase CLI when available, validate in disposable staging clone, then separately authorize target deployment and role-based proof.

requirements.requirement: Machine-readable Office staging dependency rehearsal blocks obsolete historical migration replay and enumerates role/rollback proof before any schema mutation.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: RLS effective access cannot be claimed verified by metadata-only or empty-table inspection.

notes: Bounded U11B prerequisite of Core #1186; not the staging DDL itself. Main SHA 6654cfefdb4f5b5521b017e87890cca4155c0bd3. Post-merge CI 38227287785 SUCCESS. Waterk-staging 113 applied migrations; historical Office privacy and team split versions absent. All office_threads, office_messages and office_tasks empty, RLS enabled but 3 authenticated ALL policies; no participant/current-user helpers, and no authenticated/service table grants according to read-only catalog. public.evaluate_store_capability_v1 absent. Existing normalized Block 11 sync/grants present and must be preserved. No SQL writes, backfills, tenant or production actions in this unit. SQL release and role behavior proof remain required before #1186 completion.
